templates.description: A reusable lifecycle for quarry, mineral, and concentrate operations.

stages.name: Receiving
stages.description: Receive ore, aggregate, or mineral feedstock and check the delivery note.

stages.name: Crushing
stages.description: Break down the input material to the required size.

stages.name: Screening
stages.description: Separate fine and coarse material and remove unwanted fragments.

stages.name: Washing
stages.description: Remove dust, mud, and surface contamination.

stages.name: Concentration
stages.description: Increase mineral value using process reagents or separation methods.

stages.name: Packaging
stages.description: Bag, bulk-load, or palletize the finished output.

stages.name: Dispatch
stages.description: Release the finished product with the required paperwork.

profileMappings.notes: Generic reusable lifecycle for mineral operations
